lessons.trigger_condition: V381 can learn verified champion/challenger policy preferences and compose allowlisted capability recipes, but it does not independently gate long-horizon KPI drift, verified neural-policy calibration error, temporary action quarantine, or source-gap acceptance contracts above the V381 mutation boundary
lessons.prevention_rule: V382 must preview V381 without mutation, compute bounded multi-objective KPIs and operational drift, compare neural policy scores only against verified outcomes, quarantine verified-regressing actions, keep shadow challengers advisory only, restrict high-drift execution to recovery actions, emit source-level gaps only as non-executable protected-PR/CI feature contracts, and delegate mutation to V381 only when both V381 and V382 allow it

lessons.safety_boundary: V382 expands adaptive governance only; it never auto-generates or rewrites source code, executes arbitrary commands, writes Git/main, weakens verification, promotes trust/facts/prices/grades, infers market direction, or claims physical-device success without evidence
